fusions.name: Through the Gap
fusions.desc: You slip the staff through an opening in an enemy's guard up to 4 tiles away, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Showman's Twirl
fusions.desc: You twirl the staff in a showy circle, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Each has a 15% chance to turn on its neighbours for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Doubled Back
fusions.desc: You vault 2 tiles aside on the staff, then move 30% faster with +10% dodge chance for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Feint Before the Blow
fusions.desc: When a run of your staff blows has gone without a critical hit, you feint and your critical hit chance rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
